errors.evidence: The description states the value range spans up to 4 × 10⁻⁴, but the tallest bar (at index 46) only reaches approximately 3 × 10⁻⁴, a value the description itself correctly identifies later. The value 4 × 10⁻⁴ is an overestimation of the maximum value in the chart.

The description fails to mention the overall trend shown in the chart: sensitivity generally increases as the block index increases, with an exception for the first few blocks. This is a key takeaway from the visualization.
